key.name: provider
key.description: Select the source for the daily background image.

key.name: language
key.description: Select the language for image descriptions (if supported).

key.name: auto-translate
key.description: Enable automatic translation using MyMemory API if the description is not available in the target language.

key.name: enable-bing
key.description: Whether Bing should be included in the auto rotation.

key.name: enable-wikimedia
key.description: Whether Wikimedia should be included in the auto rotation.

key.name: picture-options
key.description: Select how the image should be placed on the desktop.
